description: Patch CV is an AI career assistant. Users can review their saved job analyses with match scores, strengths and gaps, inspect any single analysis in full, read their career profile and skills, and keep a library of reusable application answers they can save and reuse in job application forms. Each user signs in with their own account, and all data is scoped to that user.

defaultPrompt: Get all analysis from my account.
